Task #186. The 30.8 GB store held two copies of one history: semantic_events.payload 15.0 GB (checkpoints 7,506 MB + model-call span inputs 7,507 MB) and delivery_outbox 15,523 MB over 573,690 rows, ALL delivered=1, mirroring those same payloads. Nothing ever removed a delivered outbox row.

Delivered outbox rows are safe to remove:
- pending_outbox_v1 is the only reader (`delivered = 0 AND delivery_cursor > ?`); pipeline.rs does the same.
- verify_durable_commit (which quarantines the store on Partial) re-checks only the batch being committed right now, whose rows are still undelivered.
- insert_outbox takes the next cursor from MAX(delivery_cursor) under a UNIQUE index, so the newest records must stay: purge_delivered_outbox(k) deletes only `delivered = 1 AND delivery_cursor <= MAX - k`.
- mark_outbox_delivered returns UnknownOutbox when the row is gone and drain_committed_outbox propagates that error: OUTBOX_RETAINED_V1 = 512 is the ack grace.
